What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/ec49fd62dd7b742e022ff259fe82ae6798872841d8f963b19626138280aedf9c.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,-4).$
